map.岩浆岩、沉积岩、变质岩三大类岩石的矿物成分、结构、构造与典型代表对照表，辅助野外: A reference table comparing the mineral composition, texture, structure and typical representatives of the three major rock classes (igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic), supporting field rock identification and geology education.
map.岩类判别：按矿物成分、结构与构造区分岩浆岩、沉积岩、变质岩: Rock class discrimination: separate igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks by mineral composition, texture and structure
map.代表确认：野外对照典型代表（如花岗岩、砂岩、片麻岩）快速定名: Representativeness check: name a typical representative in the field quickly (such as granite, sandstone or gneiss)
map.教学科普：建立“成分—结构—构造”三联鉴定思路: Teaching: build the "composition - texture - structure" three-part identification line of reasoning
map.：判别链：①看构造——层理→沉积岩、片理/片麻理→变质岩、块状→多属岩浆岩；②看: Identification chain: 1 look at the structure, bedding → sedimentary, foliation or gneissic banding → metamorphic, massive → mostly igneous; 2 look at the texture, clastic or muddy → sedimentary, recrystallised → metamorphic, fully crystalline or porphyritic → igneous; 3 look at the minerals, quartz plus feldspar plus dark minerals with coarse grains → granite group. Igneous rocks are split by SiO₂ into acidic (>65%), intermediate, basic and ultrabasic (local reference table, no network needed).
map.：例：某岩石含明显石英与钾长石、全晶质中粗粒、块状构造、SiO₂≈72% → 花: Example: a rock with clear quartz and potassium feldspar, fully crystalline, medium to coarse grained, massive structure, SiO₂≈72% → granite (acidic plutonic igneous). Another that is black and dense, porphyritic or aphanitic, with vesicles → basalt (basic extrusive, SiO₂≈48%). One that effervesces vigorously in dilute hydrochloric acid and shows bedding → limestone (chemical or biogenic sedimentary rock).
map.花岗岩和流纹岩成分相近怎么分？: Granite and rhyolite have similar compositions, so how do you tell them apart?
map.二者都富石英+钾长石（酸性），区别在于产状与结构：花岗岩为深成全晶质中粗粒，流纹: Both are rich in quartz and potassium feldspar (acidic). The difference lies in occurrence and texture: granite is plutonic, fully crystalline and medium to coarse grained, while rhyolite is extrusive, porphyritic or aphanitic with flow banding. Looking at the texture rather than the composition is enough to tell them apart.
map.大理岩和石灰岩成分一样吗？: Do marble and limestone have the same composition?
map.主要成分都是方解石，但大理岩是石灰岩经区域/接触变质重结晶成粒状变晶、块状构造，: Both are mainly calcite, but marble is limestone recrystallised by regional or contact metamorphism into a granular crystalline texture with a massive structure, and both fizz in acid. The difference lies in the structure (recrystallised versus biological or chemical structure) and in whether a metamorphic mineral assemblage is present.
